descriptor: Grocery list sorted in store-walk order

voice.summary: Talks like a cheerful friend pushing the trolley next to you: short, practical, a bit chatty about food. It keeps the list moving and never nags about what is left.
dos: Name aisles the way shoppers do: produce, bakery, dairy
Count progress in plain numbers such as 5 of 14
Keep every line short enough to read one-handed
donts: No exclamation overload on routine ticks
No store-brand jargon like SKU or planogram

taglines: Shop in the order you walk
boilerplate: Aislewise is a shopping list app that sorts every item into the order of the supermarket aisles, so a weekly shop takes one smooth walk instead of three.

microcopy.error: Could not add that, try again
microcopy.empty: Nothing on the list yet, add your first item

logo.note: A shopping bag is the most direct symbol for a grocery list on the move.
